text:
Select: assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value
Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures
Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
    assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid
    activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
    molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293237'
    activities.bao_endpoint = 'IC50'
    activities.standard_relation = '='
    activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
Limit: 1000
